fields.v: Agent: OpenCode (Plan + Build agents). Success criteria stated per library (compiles with python -m compileall; Passed = all original tests pass), but no criterion for when a configuration works; values aggregated per instruction category (16 combinations containing it x 5 libraries = 80 variants per category and model). (1) Agent files + OpenCode + Gemma 4-26B-A4B (local): compile 88.39% overall (RepoOvw 87.50, FuncDec 81.25, ImpDetl 86.25, TestCas 88.75, ReConStp 86.25); Passed 0% for all categories; Partial 13.75-20.00% (FuncDec highest 20.00), overall 17.42%; Failed 80.00-86.25%; agent-file generation tokens 68,070-415,253 (code-generation cost not measured). Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors. (2) Agent files + OpenCode + GPT-5.4 (API): compile 98.06% overall (97.50-98.75); Passed 6.25% (ImpDetl) to 16.25% (ReConStp), overall 12.99%; Partial 50.00-58.75% (overall 51.32%); Failed 33.75-36.25%; tokens 78,148-888,781 (highest RepoOvw-FuncDec-ImpDetl-ReConStp on compactor). Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors. Structural similarity: total CC and FC close to originals (Gemma within 2.47% for 3 libraries; GPT within 13.58% for 4), LoF and FL far smaller (-16% to -98%)

Configurations: 31 instruction-category combinations x 2 LLMs (Gemma 4-26B-A4B, GPT-5.4) in one harness (OpenCode); no baseline without agent file. Repetitions: 1 run per library and combination. Human intervention: Not stated (plan review possible). Experiments in April 2026

fields.v: Token usage not determined by number of categories; model and library matter more (compactor highest). GPT-5.4 > Gemma 4 on compile (98.06 vs 88.39%) and tests (12.99% vs 0% full pass). Best category: ReConStp for GPT-5.4 full pass (16.25%, +3.75 points over next), FuncDec for Gemma partial (20%, +1.25). More categories do not improve correctness (best with 1-3 categories). ReConStp most frequent among closest LoF and CC; TestCas and ReConStp for FL and FC. No statistical tests

fields.v: Inconsistencies: filter text requires <= 35 LoF or max CC <= 10, but Table II LoF values are 1,156-26,395 (only CC filter holds); RQ2a answer says Testing had the highest compilation rate, but in Table V GPT-5.4 ties at 98.75% for four categories (Testing highest only for Gemma, 88.75%); Table V has "86,25". RQ1b answer says the two lowest-token combinations both included Function Description and Implementation Detail, but in Table IV the second lowest (Gemma 4) is ImpDetl alone (69,344, areyoustillthere), after FuncDec-ImpDetl (68,070); the third, FuncDec-ImpDetl-ReConStp (70,283), fits the claim. Conclusion (p. 10) says Testing was most frequent for File Count, while the results (p. 7) and the abstract say Testing and Reconstruction Steps tied (11 of 16). Overall GPT-5.4 rates 12.99% passed and 51.32% partial are not whole counts out of 155 variants (extractor's check: 20/155 = 12.90%); denominator not stated. Tables III, IV, VII flattened by pdftotext; Table VI values read by column order. Replication package: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.23359831 (agent files, metrics, scripts). Pre-registration: not claimed. Language: Python
